policies.solar_kpno_kurucz2005_corrected: solar_kpno_kurucz2005_corrected: kpno_solar_atlas is registered telluric_required=no on basis 'line_selection', so tellurics are handled by per-line clean-line selection over 9 enumerated bands (RYA-460/786), not by a correction stage. telluric_applied=applied. No telluric_corrected declaration is made.
policies.solar_iag: solar_iag: iag_fts_solar_atlas is registered telluric_required=no on basis 'corrected', so tellurics are handled by per-line clean-line selection over 9 enumerated bands (RYA-460/786), not by a correction stage. telluric_applied=applied. No telluric_corrected declaration is made.

caveats: Frozen spectra, original AIR holding/internal RT vacuum. Gaussian approximations only; no measured FTS kernel, fitted R, preferred reference, abundance or physical-error inference. No second telluric correction. Both earlier RV residual legs remain unchanged.
